Centre of Examination

The Centre of Examination conducts all evaluations of the university. The examination means any type of evaluation such as theory, practical, oral, seminar, presentation or on screen examination.

Unfair means

Referring to a website link, shared files, downloaded material or a software tool which is prohibited by the examiner during the on screen examination is considered an unfair means.

Carrying any electronic gadget such as a mobile phone or smart watch into the examination hall is not allowed.
